Time Management · Module 1

Take Control of Multiple Tasks

See the work. Sort the work. Decide the next move.

Participant eWorkbook Objective 1 45 minutes
Module focus: This workbook helps participants spot where time is being consumed, classify the type of drain, and organize next moves using the group activities in Module 1.
Quick reference

What consumes your time?

Use these three types of time drains as a reference during the activity.

External demands

Interruptions, meetings, unclear requests, system issues

Self-created habits

Procrastination, overcommitting, perfectionism, task switching

Process friction

Unclear ownership, rework, missing information, duplicated effort

Activity 1

Your Top Time Drains

Work individually first, then compare your choices with a partner.

10 MINUTES
1
Identify
Capture your top three time drains.
2
Classify
Choose Control, Influence, or Adapt for each one.
Time drain spotlight

Where is your time slipping away?

Use the graphic as a reminder to look for the places where work seems to disappear down the drain. First name the drain, then decide whether you can control it, influence it, or need to adapt around it.

Control

I can change my own behavior or system.

Influence

It needs a conversation, agreement, or process change.

Adapt

It is part of the job. Plan around it.

Activity 2

Clean Up the Task Pile

As a small group, sort each item into the zone that best fits.

10 MINUTES · GROUPS OF 3–5
How to use the board: Drag each card into a zone. You can also use the move menu on each card, which supports keyboard-only use and screen readers.
